name: sennosides a and b
uses: Uses relieve occasional constipation (irregularity) this product generally produces a bowel movement in 6 to 12 hours
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have stomach pain nausea vomiting noticed a sudden change in bowel habits that continues over a period of 2 weeks Stop use and ask a doctor if you have rectal bleeding or fail to have a bowel movement after use of a laxative. These may indicate a serious condition.
